gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gentium-plus: Loose, inked and a bit cheeky, Gabarito draws its crossbars as chunky as its stems and shines big and short. And Gentium Plus, a refined serif, brings a lighter hand with the wide mouth of a pitcher in each c.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-gowun-batang: Gowun Batang is a literary serif whose terminals are cut back to leave a big gap, while Gabarito has no tilted stress in its rounds. The result is a lively, expressive headline over a quiet page.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-habibi: Traditional in spirit, Habibi gives its text serif a clear channel leading into every round letter, under a Gabarito heading that looks bent from wire. Paragraphs run smooth and unhurried.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-inika: Classic in manner, Inika is a serif that leaves a gap you can see through in each s. Gabarito's bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mix inside a word, so Inika softens the page beneath it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kay-pho-du: Gabarito is the expressive display voice, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward, over Kay Pho Du's serif with its rolling-ball pen trail. The mix of distinctive and traditional is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-labrada: Labrada, a bookish text serif, opens wide on its small letters and feels dignified for it. But Gabarito's rhythm of identical bar thickness across the line gives the pair its strongest quality: a clear split of character.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-laila: Bold and inky, Gabarito turns its curves with no pressure swell at the corner. And Laila, an editorial serif, leaves generous space between curve ends and the stem, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-montaga: Bookish and quiet, Montaga stitches its strokes like thread along a path. Gabarito, expressive and drawn with one nib, takes the louder part above while the classic serif follows with its unfinished loops.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-new-tegomin: Gabarito keeps one unit-width stroke throughout, from letter to letter. Beneath it, New Tegomin's text serif feels dignified and traditional, its c a wide-open ring that carries a long page gently.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-podkova: Podkova reads bookish and traditional, its c a broad, welcoming opening. Gabarito's constant pen pressure look sits above that serif, so the headline feels playful and the text underneath feels settled.
